_comment: Per-machine planned-hours baseline master. This is the denominator for utilisation and output-efficiency. It does NOT change how output/hours are read from the sheets; it only sets the target each machine is measured against. A machine with no entry here has NO real baseline, so its utilisation/efficiency are suppressed ('baseline not set') and raw hours + output are shown instead — this is an advisory, non-blocking flag, never a gate. IMPORTANT: ship ONLY real, business-supplied planned hours here. Do NOT enter estimates or the sheet's flat 500-h placeholder. PIPE and MOULDING currently have no shift-pattern data, so they have no entries on purpose. HDPE/PTMT self-supply their ideal in-sheet; GARDEN/TANK are output-only. Edit this file to add machines as real data becomes available; no code change needed. 'machines' keys are matched case- and whitespace-insensitively against the full machine code (e.g. 'MOULDING M/C - 4'). 'overrides' lets a specific YYYY-MM use different planned hours. 'ideal_output_rate' (units/hour) is optional; when omitted, output-efficiency keeps the sheet's own ideal-output figure.
